label.purpose: Metadata captions and section eyebrows (LIVE / SHADOW), uppercase, wide tracking.

mono.purpose: All machine data: URLs, paths, methods, status codes, latencies, JSON.

shadows.name: control-xs
shadows.purpose: Minimal functional shadow on interactive controls only (inputs, outline buttons). Cards never cast shadow at rest (The Flat-By-Default Rule).

motion.name: transition-colors
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus state transition on cards, rows, and controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-emphasis action; Ink fill with inverse foreground.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--primary, #18181b); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fafafa); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #18181b) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #a1a1aa) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action; transparent until hover shifts to the zinc accent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #09090b); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--accent, #f4f4f5); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #a1a1aa) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Transparent field, 1px zinc border, minimal functional shadow, focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2.25rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--input, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #09090b); font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #71717a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, #a1a1aa); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #a1a1aa) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Fully-round chip, semantic tint at low alpha over its signal color, paired with a dot.
components.css: .ds-badge-diff { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger, #ef4444) 10%, transparent); color: var(--danger, #ef4444); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-diff .ds-dot { width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--danger, #ef4444); }

components.name: Method Badge
components.description: Signature: HTTP verb tinted from a fixed map (GET = Signal Blue, POST = Signal Green) in a fixed-width monospace pill.
components.css: .ds-method { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 3.5rem; padding: 0.125rem 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--info, #3b82f6) 15%, transparent); color: var(--info, #3b82f6); font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Gate Card
components.description: Flat bordered container; hover shifts border and background rather than lifting.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--card-foreground, #09090b); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--ring, #a1a1aa); background: var(--accent, #f4f4f5); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, #a1a1aa); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-url { display: inline-block; margin-top: 0.5rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--accent, #f4f4f5); color: var(--muted-foreground, #71717a); font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Diff Rate Readout
components.description: Signature: value-driven color (green <1%, amber 1-10%, red >=10%) always shown alongside the numeric value (The Color-Is-Never-Alone Rule).
components.css: .ds-diffrate { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.375rem; color: var(--danger, #ef4444); font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-diffrate-label { color: var(--muted-foreground, #71717a); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
mroki-hub is a calm, dark-capable operations dashboard for engineers deciding whether a shadow service behaves like production. It is dense but legible: every pixel earns its place by carrying signal, and decoration is treated as noise. The interface is built almost entirely from a near-monochrome zinc foundation so that the moment a semantic color appears - a red diff rate, a tinted method badge, a highlighted JSON key - it means something. Color is a readout, not a mood.

The system is quiet and restrained by design. Chrome recedes; data (URLs, paths, status codes, JSON) is set in monospace and given the foreground. It is unmistakably a developer tool - keyboard-operable, information-first - but a composed one, closer to instrumentation than to a terminal. Depth is nearly flat: surfaces are separated by hairline borders and subtle tonal fills rather than shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Near-monochrome zinc base; semantic color reserved for actual signal.
Flat surfaces, hairline borders, tonal layering instead of elevation.
Monospace for all machine data; system sans for chrome and prose.
Full light/dark parity - every token has both values.
Color never carries meaning alone; it accompanies a number or label.

rules.name: The Signal-Sparingly Rule
rules.body: The zinc foundation carries the interface; semantic accents mark only attention - status, method, diff. If a color is not reporting a fact, it does not appear.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Never-Alone Rule
rules.body: Color is emphasis, never the sole signal. The diff rate always shows its number; status always shows its code. Remove the color and the meaning must survive.

rules.name: The Monospace-For-Data Rule
rules.body: If a value came from the wire - a URL, path, method, status, latency, or JSON - it is set in monospace. Prose and chrome are never monospace; data never is not.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. A border or a tonal fill separates layers; a shadow appears only on an interactive control (input, outline button) to signal it can be manipulated - never for decoration or to lift a card.

dos: Do build from Instrument Zinc first and add a semantic signal only when it reports a fact (status, method, diff).
Do set every wire-derived value (URL, path, method, status, latency, JSON) in monospace.
Do keep surfaces flat - separate layers with a 1px zinc border or a tonal fill, and reserve shadow-xs for interactive controls.
Do pair every color signal with a number or label so meaning survives without color.
Do provide a visible 3px focus ring and full keyboard operability on every control.
Do ship both light and dark values for any new token.
donts: Don't use a semantic accent for decoration, emphasis, or 'brand color' fills.
Don't add ambient shadows to cards, lists, or panels to create depth.
Don't set interface chrome or prose in monospace, or body data in the sans stack.
Don't introduce a raw Tailwind palette swatch (text-sky-400) - use the semantic or syntax tokens so both themes stay correct.
Don't convey state with color alone (no bare red dot without its value).
